mapper.select: SELECT ar.*, s.student_name FROM attendance_records ar LEFT JOIN students s ON ar.student_id = s.student_id WHERE ar.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY s.student_name
SELECT ar.*, s.student_name FROM attendance_records ar LEFT JOIN students s ON ar.student_id = s.student_id WHERE ar.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY ar.create_time DESC

SELECT record_id AS recordId, course_id AS courseId, student_id AS studentId, sign_time AS signTime, status, create_time AS createTime FROM attendance_records WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(ar.create_time) as date, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.student_id, ar.course_id) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status = '已签到' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as signed FROM attendance_records ar JOIN courses c ON ar.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND DATE(ar.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(ar.create_time) ORDER BY DATE(ar.create_time) ASC

SELECT ar.record_id AS recordId, ar.course_id AS courseId, ar.student_id AS studentId, ar.sign_time AS signTime, ar.status, ar.create_time AS createTime, s.student_name AS studentName, c.course_name AS courseName, c.class_name AS className FROM attendance_records ar JOIN courses c ON ar.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN students s ON ar.student_id = s.student_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND DATE(ar.create_time) = #{date} ORDER BY c.course_name, s.student_name

SELECT ar.record_id AS recordId, ar.course_id AS courseId, ar.sign_time AS signTime, ar.status, ar.create_time AS createTime, c.course_name AS courseName, c.class_name AS className FROM attendance_records ar JOIN courses c ON ar.course_id = c.course_id WHERE ar.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY ar.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT ar.student_id, MAX(CASE WHEN ar.status = '已签到' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_signed, MAX(CASE WHEN ar.status = '缺勤' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_absent, MAX(CASE WHEN ar.status = '迟到' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_late FROM attendance_records ar JOIN courses c ON ar.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY ar.student_id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) FROM students s JOIN courses c ON s.class_name = c.class_name WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId}
